headline: ADNOC Chief Warns Global Energy Supply Buffers Have Eroded
summary: ADNOC CEO Sultan Al Jaber stated that the global energy system has drained nearly 1 billion barrels of crude inventories and eroded supply buffers following traffic disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: ADNOC is a major state-owned energy producer, and global oil inventory levels directly dictate petroleum price volatility and supply security.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Depleted global inventories and supply buffer concerns put upward pressure on energy prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Warnings of severely depleted global crude inventories and compromised transit routes directly tighten perceived market supply.
